items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Finally, we made up a little, an orchestra, you know, six piece... this fella, what, I call you Jack Paeda, what they call him, he was playing trumpet... I was on the bass drum... Julius Gronison, he was playing bass... Ernest, uh, Silvey, he was playing clarinet... Booz Silvey, he was playing, uh,

ctx.x: That was, he's dead, and a fella called Jack, used to call him Jack Paeda. On the piccolo?
